name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Dragon's Breath DB-8 'Kiln'
description:
A precision thermal lance rifle that fires a concentrated plasma bolt at hypersonic velocities. Unlike continuous-beam thermal weapons, the Dragon's Breath packages its energy into a discrete projectile — a magnetically-contained plasma mass roughly the size of a marble that maintains coherence for approximately 800 meters before dispersing.

Zheng-Dao developed the DB-8 for anti-armor precision work. The plasma bolt delivers approximately 40 megajoules of thermal energy on impact, sufficient to melt through 15cm of composite armor plating. Against personnel, the effect is catastrophic and leaves forensic evidence that is difficult to interpret — investigators unfamiliar with the weapon initially classify DB-8 kills as industrial accidents.

The weapon requires a dedicated cooling system that circulates liquid nitrogen through the barrel assembly between shots, giving the rifle its characteristic frost-coated appearance in the field.
legality: Military restricted — heavy weapons authorization and thermal weapons permit
specifications:
caliber: Plasma bolt, 12mm containment diameter
effective_range: 100-800 meters
rate_of_fire: 1 shot per 15 seconds (cooling cycle)
capacity: 8 plasma charges
weight: 14 kg rifle, 6 kg cooling pack
power_source: Dual fusion cell, 16 shots per charge pair
tactical_use: The Kiln fills a niche between conventional anti-materiel rifles and directed energy weapons. Its plasma bolt penetrates targets that would shrug off conventional rounds, while its discrete-projectile nature avoids the sustained-beam detection signatures that betray conventional thermal weapons. Operators deploy the DB-8 against fortified positions, armored vehicles, and hardened command posts where a single precision strike can change the tactical situation.
cultural_context: Zheng-Dao's weapons division has a reputation for building equipment that is simultaneously elegant and terrifying. The Dragon's Breath embodies this philosophy — a weapon of extraordinary precision that kills through localized incineration. In corporate conflict zones, the discovery of plasma-scorched impact craters is enough to trigger evacuation protocols.
story_hooks: A DB-8 plasma bolt struck a residential building in Tier 3, melting through the exterior wall and killing a family inside. The intended target was in the building next door. Someone is using heavy weapons with unacceptable collateral risk.
Zheng-Dao is developing a rapid-fire variant of the Dragon's Breath that eliminates the cooling cycle — if they succeed, it will be the most destructive man-portable weapon in GLMZ.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist precision instrument with aggressive thermal management—long, angular sniper profile dominated by a massive cryogenically-jacketed barrel assembly. The weapon has an ominous, purposeful stance: all hard lines, heat dissipation fins, and barely-contained industrial violence. Frost perpetually clings to its exterior, giving it an almost cursed appearance.
physical_description.dimensions: 145cm total length, 8cm barrel diameter (with cooling jacket), 6cm width at receiver, scope rails extending 18cm above centerline
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial but balanced—14kg rifle feels distributed across the lengthy barrel and stock. The 6kg cooling pack mounts dorsally, shifting weight toward the user's support shoulder. Hefty without being unwieldy; designed for mounted or braced fire.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-alloy barrel assembly with integrated cryogenic circulation channels, reinforced polymer composite stock, hardened steel receiver
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with persistent frost coating on all thermal surfaces. Heat-scorched carbon scoring around the muzzle where plasma containment fields collapse. Cooling jacket shows faint ice crystal patterns and thermal stress discoloration—purples and blues from repeated cryogenic cycling.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary, with accent bands of deep blue-purple frost discoloration on barrel. Muzzle ring glows faintly amber at the plasma generation point when powered. Cooling pack's circulation tubes visible through semi-transparent polymer—liquid nitrogen flows in pale blue.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip with integrated thermal glove anchor points. Slightly tacky to prevent slipping from condensation. Magazine well has raised ridges for gloved manipulation.
distinctive_features: Crystalline frost formations permanently etched into barrel cooling jacket—never fully melts
Prominent muzzle ring with magnetic containment coils visible as concentric circles
Vertical cooling pack mounted above stock with transparent circulation windows showing cryogenic fluid flow
Dual thermal status LEDs (one for barrel temp, one for plasma charge level) embedded in stock
Heat stress scarring radiating from muzzle like burn marks
Zheng-Dao ideogram stamped on cooling pack in copper-colored inlay
Cryogenic warning labels in Mandarin and English on cooling pack
Precision elevation/windage adjusters with thermal compensation scales
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES logo on cooling pack in embossed copper. Serial number and thermal weapons registration plate mounted on left receiver side in small brass inset. Pressure relief valve caps labeled with ideographic safety warnings.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field units show heavy frost accumulation, scorch marks around the muzzle expanding in concentric rings from repeated shots. Cooling tubes may show slight discoloration from extended use. Polymer stock develops micro-fractures from thermal cycling. Dust and ice buildup in cooling fins—operators must regularly purge with compressed air to maintain heat dissipation.
